name: Wren Hollowmere
title: Batwing Archer
direction: Young woman, alert listening expression and dry confidence. Preserve approved violet/magenta/gold bat-shaped hood, wing-edged cloak, ornate gold bow, compact scale. Dark hair, distinctive bat ears on hood. Held bow, no summoned swarm. Do not copy Pip's fire equipment.

name: Tobin Reed
title: Hedge Squire
direction: Compact youthful male squire, determined kind face, tousled chestnut hair. Preserve approved red scarf/cape, borrowed straight sword held in hand and modest round shield. Patched practical clothes with limited armour, not an ornate professional knight. Sword and shield stay held.

name: Pip Cinderly
title: Hedge Mage
direction: Reuse supplied Concept 04 unchanged: orange hair, moss hood, russet coat, fire-orb staff, belt lantern and book.

name: Old Hesketh
title: Lamplighter
direction: Elderly man with bowed but stubborn posture, deeply lined kind face, grey moustache and sparse hair. Long ochre and ink-blue service coat, worn leather boots. Low copper maintenance lantern and short lighting rod, tool loop. Lamp worker rather than wizard. Warm amber light, grounded maintenance craftsmanship.

name: Bram Hollis
title: Woodcutter
direction: Broad middle-aged male woodcutter, gruff caring face, dark cropped hair and heavy beard, strong exposed forearms. Pine-green and brown work coat, rolled sleeves, leather work gloves, long wood axe held naturally, timber belt wedges. Broad powerful outline, no knight armour or shield.

name: Maren Ashvale
title: Lampwarden
direction: Adult woman gravekeeper, exhausted but resolute face, ash-brown hair tied low. Bone and charcoal mantle, bronze weathered held shield and quiet iron sword. Small inscribed name strips tied to belt, dim warm grave-lamp accent. Protective solemn silhouette distinct from a heraldic knight.

name: Ser Aldric Vane
title: Oathbound
direction: Mature male knight, formal weary composure, iron-grey hair and short beard. Dented silver plate, attached torn crimson standard hanging behind shoulder, keychain at belt, straight held sword. Noble but visibly used equipment, crimson/silver/old gold. No pristine fantasy prince.

name: Kestrel Thane
title: Skyfall Dragoon
direction: Adult female mountain veteran, guarded sharp-eyed face, cropped dark hair. Close-fitting pale steel and ochre armour, narrow split coat, upright spear held grounded. Lean angular climbing silhouette, practical boots, mountain weather marks. No wings, flight, airborne pose or thrown spear.

name: Thessaly Gloam
title: Bog Seer
direction: Tall adult woman marsh seer, patient evasive face, dark damp-looking braided hair. Marsh-grey and muted teal reed-pattern robes, shallow sealed jar at belt, crooked reed-topped staff. Wading boots, layered reed shawl, subtle pale marsh-light accent. No combat stilts, giant witch hat or fire staff.

name: Brother Anselm
title: Bellringer
direction: Round strong middle-aged man, gentle grieving expression, shaved crown and warm brown beard. Bronze and cream monk garments, large heavy bell securely harnessed at hip, held short wooden mallet. Thick boots and visible harness straps support weight. Warm brass sound theme, not a cleric with a sword.

name: Grenna Holt
title: Stonebreaker
direction: Broad muscular adult female quarry worker, blunt proud face, dark braided hair. Slate and chalk work layers, rust leather apron, battered knuckles and gloves. Short square-headed maul held down near body, stone chips in apron pocket. Compact rectangular silhouette, no shield or long wood axe.

name: Isolde Marrow
title: Duskblade
direction: Adult woman with terse watchful face, straight dark cropped hair. Fitted smoke-grey working leathers, short close cloak, low held short blade, sealed contract case at hip. Practical quiet movement and asymmetric belt, subdued plum accents. No long court sword, exaggerated assassin armour or bow.

name: Oriel Vess
title: Starcaller
direction: Adult female sky reader, upright and dryly scrutinising, dark blue-black hair in a practical knot. Midnight-blue and cream robe, tall staff with tiny warm star fragment enclosed in brass, brass folding sky-chart frame. Precise celestial geometry, restrained pale-gold glow. No giant moon crown or fire mage costume.

name: Morwen Tallow
title: Candlewitch
direction: Adult woman with proprietary warm smile, auburn-brown hair under modest wrapped headwear. Plum working dress and moss-green wax accents, garden satchel and short hand-held candle rack, wax-dripped gloves. Familiar domestic witchcraft, green candle light. No oversized Pip-like hat or orb staff.

name: Vesper Lark
title: Songweaver
direction: Slim adult female travelling musician, lively friendly face, wavy chestnut hair. Blue and russet travelling coat, held lute with worn wood and brass fittings, old songbook at hip. Expressive free hand, warm confident stance, modest ribbons. No sword or fire staff.

name: Saint Elowen
title: Last Lantern
direction: Adult woman saint whose face is visibly worn and compassionate rather than pristine. Simple pale linen mantle over faded grey clothing, low held small-flame lantern, unadorned boots, frayed edges. Pale ivory and soft gold light, costly mercy and resolve. No enormous halo, crown or ornate armour.

name: Caedmon the Unburnt
title: Ashen Knight
direction: Large mature male knight, severe tireless weathered face, dark hair with grey ash streaks. Heavy blackened plate with restrained orange ember seams, long held sword, scorched short mantle. Black iron, charcoal and burnt orange, massive grounded posture. No shield, huge flames or Pip orb.

name: Corvin Black
title: Hollow King's Blade
direction: Older male court swordsman, straight-backed, silver-streaked hair and restrained judging expression. Worn charcoal long court coat, plain belt, long narrow held blade, subtle old silver closures. Tall controlled silhouette, minimal decoration. No short assassin knife, royal crown or bow.

name: Cass Penhallow
title: Reef Hunter
direction: Weathered adult female coastal hunter, brisk practical expression, wind-tangled dark hair tied back. Waxed short sea coat in faded petrol blue, rope sash, salt-worn boots, two-handed hooked harpoon held close and planted. Coral-rust details, sea-worn buckles. No thrown harpoon, loose nets or pirate costume.

name: Loveday Penrow
title: Keeper's Daughter
direction: Adult woman lighthouse keeper's daughter, precise and quietly angry face, dark tightly tied hair. Muted golden oilskin over light robe, brass shutter lantern held low, waist lens case with optical tools. Strong clean coastal silhouette, ivory/brass/ink blue. Lighthouse precision, not saintly robes or candles.

name: Davy Ashby
title: Water-Carrier
direction: Broad-shouldered adult man with friendly stubborn endurance, short brown hair and stubble. Rough blue-grey work shirt and heavy canvas trousers, shoulder yoke with two securely attached water cans, short oak cudgel held at side. Copper and pale blue water accents. Adult, not the nine-year-old from backstory; no throwing cans.

name: Ferrin Slake
title: Kiln Rat
direction: Lean hunched adult man, evasive humorous face, soot-smudged dark hair. Patched soot-grey short coat, resting protective mask on neck, low narrow breaching pick held, strapped sulphur brush at belt. Ochre soot highlights, practical kiln worker gear. No bombs or thrown tools.

name: Linnet Cole
title: Glassblower
direction: Adult woman with exacting patient face, tightly pinned copper-brown hair. Rolled sleeves, leather glassworker apron over cream shirt, long glassblowing pipe held upright with small glowing glass orb at tip. Glass-green and amber highlights, safety wrist wraps. Industrial craft magic, not a witch staff or lantern.

name: Oswin Hale
title: Shieldbearer
direction: Small adult male patched squire, polite uncertain brave face, sandy unruly hair. Dominant oversized scorched held shield, short retained sword, patched olive tunic and worn mail pieces. Shield almost as large as torso, muted olive/iron/brown. No Tobin red scarf and no shield throw.

name: Hob Tarrow
title: Icehouse Man
direction: Stocky middle-aged man with complaining but kind face, thick brown beard. Thick sleeveless work vest over wool layers, felt cap, held ice saw angled safely down and short belt ice hook. Frost-grey, dark blue and brown leather. Warehouse worker with sturdy boots, not berserker fur armour.

name: Beatrix Fairweather
title: Wandering Scholar
direction: Adult female wandering scholar, generous incisive face, round spectacles, dark hair in loose practical bun. Weathered teal travel cloak, cream layers, held notebook and quill focus, small ink case. Paper and ink magic suggested by subtle gold marks. Practical curious academic, no giant pointed hat or staff.

name: Eskil Hauk
title: Pass Scout
direction: Compact adult male mountain scout, meticulous reserved face, dark hair. Mountain hood, cropped slate-green cloak, practical recurved held bow and quiver, small cairn charm, wrapped weather boots. Muted stone/green/russet. No Wren bat hood, purple wing cloak or ornate gold bow.

name: Brynja Berg
title: Doorward
direction: Broad adult woman with immovable hospitable face, ash-brown braided hair. Square heavy ochre cloak, held iron door bar grounded close to body, safely enclosed hip brazier, stout boots. Rust iron and amber warmth. Door defender and shelter keeper, no shield throw or open flame weapon.

name: Inga Fallow
title: Stardigger
direction: Adult woman earthy star surveyor, obsessive sceptical face, practical dark braid. Angled surveying hood, slate-brown field coat, shard-capped auger staff held grounded, measuring chain and brass calipers. Earth ochre with small cold star glint. Ground survey geometry, no celestial queen crown or Oriel robe.

name: Ragna Vik
title: Lichen-Witch
direction: Older adult female winter forager with sardonic face and grey braids. Shaggy herb mantle over moss and plum wool, hooked held staff, closed kettle secured to belt, winter boots. Lichen-grey, muted violet, herb green. Rugged botanical craft, no enormous hat, Pip fire staff or loose throwable kettle.

name: Solveig Lund
title: Sill-Candle
direction: Adult woman with quiet domestic stubbornness and weathered kind face, fair hair tucked under plain knitted cap. Plain wool shawl, mittens, low held lantern with visibly sheltered candle, practical long skirt and winter boots. Muted blue, cream and candle gold. Modest home guardian, not lamp maintenance coat or rod.

name: Asta Grey
title: Pass Guide
direction: Older adult female seasoned mountain guide, forty years of routes in lined observant face, greying hair. Broad weathered hat, short practical cloak, grounded held trekking staff, enclosed ember charm and route ribbons. Stone-grey, ochre and faded red markers, stout mountain boots. Brisk experienced trail reader, no bow or witch hat.
